grants.title: Early-Career Awards
grants.amount: Salary plus up to £400,000 for research costs
grants.who: Early-career researchers in any discipline, applying alone. No co-applicants.
grants.summary: Supports early-career researchers to build an independent research identity in human life, health and wellbeing. Three rounds a year.
grants.note: Closes at 15:00 GMT. Check that your host institution can hold Wellcome awards.
grants.src: University of Malawi funding portal listing

grants.title: Career Development Awards
grants.amount: Usually under £250,000 a year, excluding salary
grants.who: Mid-career researchers in any discipline with potential to become international research leaders.
grants.summary: Backs mid-career researchers working on human life, health and wellbeing. Three rounds a year.
grants.note: This is the full-application deadline for the current round.
grants.src: University of Malawi funding portal listing

grants.title: Discovery Awards
grants.who: Established researchers and teams in any discipline.
grants.summary: Bold discovery research in human life, health and wellbeing. Two rounds a year.
grants.note: The 22 September 2026 deadline has passed. Check Wellcome for the next round.
grants.src: University of Malawi funding portal listing

grants.title: Collaborative Network for Vaccine Research in West and East Africa
grants.funder: National Research Fund Kenya, with UNCST (Uganda), COSTECH (Tanzania) and NSTIC-SL (Sierra Leone)
grants.amount: Pool of USD 1,191,351. Up to 7 large grants of USD 156,750 and up to 2 early-career grants of USD 47,000.
grants.who: Researchers and eligible institutions in the partner countries. The full call PDF sets the exact rules.
grants.summary: Part of the CONNECT-VAX initiative. Projects run up to 36 months.
grants.note: Closes 23:59 EAT. Submit through the NRIMS portal at nrims.uncst.go.ug.

grants.title: Fogarty International Center funding opportunities
grants.who: Varies by programme.
grants.summary: Research training and international health research programmes, including HIV, non-communicable diseases, bioethics, infectious disease ecology and DS-I Africa.
grants.note: Read NIH notices NOT-OD-25-104 and NOT-OD-25-098 on foreign subawards and international partners before applying.

grants.title: IIE Scholar Rescue Fund Fellowship
grants.who: Scholars whose work or safety is threatened. See the IIE-SRF criteria.
grants.summary: An external fellowship opportunity posted on the TWAS opportunities page.
grants.note: Confirm eligibility and how to apply with IIE-SRF.

grants.title: Fourth Global Call for Initiatives, International Decade of Sciences for Sustainable Development 2024–2033
grants.who: Not stated on the listing.
grants.summary: An external call under the International Decade of Sciences for Sustainable Development, posted on the TWAS opportunities page.
grants.note: Open the call page for the full terms.

grants.title: TWAS-SISSA-Lincei Research Cooperation Visits Programme
grants.who: Not stated on the listing.
grants.summary: Research cooperation visits run by TWAS with SISSA and Lincei.
grants.note: TWAS programmes are generally for the natural sciences. Confirm eligibility on the programme page.

grants.title: TWAS Research Professors in LDCs
grants.who: Aimed at least developed countries (LDCs).
grants.summary: A TWAS visiting scientist programme.
grants.note: Kenya is generally not classed as an LDC, so check whether you qualify before you prepare an application.

grants.title: TWAS Visiting Expert Programme
grants.who: Not stated on the listing.
grants.summary: A TWAS visiting scientist programme.
grants.note: Confirm eligibility on the programme page.

grants.title: TWAS Research and Project Grants
grants.who: Individual scientists and research groups in developing countries.
grants.summary: Pays for specialised equipment and consumables, and supports Master of Science students.
grants.note: No deadline appeared on the page. Check the grant page for the current call.

grants.title: TWAS PhD and Postdoctoral Fellowships
grants.who: Applicants for a PhD (about 160 places with eight partners in six countries) or a postdoc (about 100 places with nine partners in five countries).
grants.summary: Fellowships hosted at partner institutions abroad.
grants.note: Apply only through the online portal while the call is open. You need a preliminary acceptance letter from the host issued in the same year, and you may apply to one TWAS or OWSD programme per calendar year.

grants.title: LEAP-SE 2026 Call for Proposals
grants.amount: Programme budget about €30 million. Per-project amount not stated.
grants.who: Consortia with partners from participating African Union and EU countries, Kenya included. Each national funder applies its own rules.
grants.summary: Projects run 12 to 36 months across basic research, applied research and experimental development.
grants.note: This was the full-proposal deadline, after a mandatory pre-proposal in February. Results are due mid-November 2026.

grants.title: Economics of Climate Change Adaptation in Africa
grants.who: Not stated on the listing.
grants.summary: A call for funding proposals on the economics of adapting to climate change in Africa.
grants.note: Closed in March 2026. Follow CLARE for similar calls.

grants.title: IFS Research Grants
grants.who: Early-career scientists from eligible African countries, within their first five years of independent research.
grants.summary: Covers equipment, consumables, lab supplies, travel and fieldwork.
grants.note: Sources disagree on whether all fields qualify or mainly agriculture, water and environment. Confirm on ifs.se.

grants.title: Meaning-making Research Initiatives 2026
grants.amount: Up to USD 10,000 for individuals and USD 25,000 for groups, over 16 months
grants.who: African scholars with a PhD, mainly living on the continent. Group coordinators need a PhD.
grants.summary: Research on the state and democratisation, African economies, and ecologies and society, under CODESRIA's 2023–2027 priorities.
grants.note: The call document gives no date for a 2027 round. Watch the CODESRIA site.

grants.title: IFRA-Nairobi Fieldwork Grants
grants.funder: French Institute for Research in Africa
grants.who: Master's, PhD and postdoctoral researchers in the social sciences and humanities working in East Africa.
grants.summary: Small grants for fieldwork in East Africa.
grants.note: Closed in June 2026. The funder may reopen it in a later cycle.

grants.title: African Scholarship Programme
grants.amount: Return flights, accommodation, SEK 400 a day and a SEK 2,500 installation grant
grants.who: Early-career researchers based in Africa, working on contemporary Africa in the social sciences or humanities.
grants.summary: A three-month research stay at the Institute in Uppsala.
grants.note: A third-party page gave a 31 March deadline with a mismatched year. Confirm the current window on the NAI page.

grants.title: Next Generation Social Sciences in Africa Fellowships
grants.who: Doctoral students in Africa working on local challenges.
grants.summary: Supports doctoral research on challenges facing African societies.
grants.note: No deadline appeared on the SSRC page. Open the programme page for the current call.

grants.title: African Peacebuilding Network Fellowships
grants.who: Researchers in Africa, as individuals or working groups. Details are on the programme page.
grants.summary: Individual and working-group fellowships that support local innovation of new knowledge on peacebuilding.
grants.note: No deadline appeared on the SSRC page. Open the programme page for the current call.

grants.title: Call for Research Proposals on community-level poverty reduction
grants.who: Not stated in the text.
grants.summary: Seeks projects on community-level interventions, training programmes, extension activities and policy-relevant work aimed at reducing poverty.
grants.note: The full terms sit in an image on the NRF announcement. Email info@nrf.go.ke or call 020-4403386.

grants.title: Postgraduate Research Grants NRF001/2026
grants.amount: PhD: up to KSh 2,000,000 over 3 years. Master's: up to KSh 500,000 over 1 year.
grants.who: Kenyan citizens registered full time for a Master's (under 35) or PhD (under 45) at a recognised Kenyan institution.
grants.summary: Pays research costs for postgraduate students. It cannot be used for tuition.
grants.note: Needs an endorsement letter signed by you, your supervisors, the graduate school and the head of the institution. Apply at grantsportal.nrf.go.ke.

grants.title: SGCI STISA-2034 Multi-Country Research Call
grants.funder: SGCI, funded and managed by IDRC
grants.who: African universities, public research organisations and government institutes in 20 countries, in consortia of 3 to 5 institutions from at least 3 countries.
grants.summary: Interdisciplinary, policy-relevant research that advances the African Union's STISA-2034 priorities.
grants.note: A two-stage process. This was the expression-of-interest deadline, 23:59 EDT. Portal: call.sgci.africa.

grants.title: Researcher–Sciencepreneur Collaboration Grant 2026
grants.who: A Swiss-affiliated lead with an African co-applicant. One partner comes from a research institution and one from a science-based venture.
grants.summary: Funds prototyping, co-design, market discovery and pilot testing.
grants.note: Closed in August 2026.

grants.title: Wolfson Fellowship and Wolfson Visiting Fellowship
grants.amount: Fellowship: £300,000 over 5 years. Visiting: up to £125,000 for 12 months.
grants.who: Established researchers based overseas, of any nationality, nominated by a UK host institution.
grants.summary: A placement at a UK university or research institution, or a 12-month sabbatical for international collaboration.
grants.note: Closed 1 July 2026. Hosts had to submit nomination forms by 24 June.

grants.title: Kenya-France PAMOJA PHC (6th call)
grants.funder: National Research Fund Kenya with French partners
grants.amount: Up to €23,000 per project over two years
grants.who: Joint teams with a coordinator in France and one in Kenya, each from a public scientific body. Kenyan members must live and work in Kenya at a state-authorised institution, TVET colleges included.
grants.summary: Kenya-France research cooperation, run through the NRF Grants Management System.
grants.note: The 6th call closed on 15 September 2025. Apply at grantsportal.nrf.go.ke when the next call opens.
